Hints: The denominator factors are distinct.;Include each factor once.
Solution: Factor the polynomials: x and x + 5. Take every distinct factor at its greatest exponent to obtain x*(x + 5). It is divisible by each original polynomial with no unnecessary factors. When used as a common denominator, exclude all zeros of either original denominator.
